newsitem.title: USA: API, EIA, AGA data dates for Sept 2 week.
newsitem.headline: API, EIA, AGA data dates for Sept 2 week.

text.p: The American Petroleum Institute said that, due to the Labor Day holiday Monday, its petroleum stocks data for the week ending Aug. 30 will be issued after 1630 EDT (2030 GMT) on Wednesday, Sept 4. The report is usually issued on Tuesday.
The Energy Information Administration said its petroleum stocks and output data, which is usually issued on Wednesday, will be delayed until Thursday, Sept. 5, at 0900 EDT (1300 GMT).
The American Gas Association said its weekly underground storage data will be issued as usual on Wednesday, Sept. 4 after 1600 EDT (2000 GMT).
